column4: Visit note | 2026-06-09 04:30 PM | Dr. Imran Kabir, Gastroenterology | Patient: Shampa Paul, 32, female. Mrs. Paul presents with loose watery stools, vomiting, and feeling very weak. She states that her symptoms started after eating biryani at a roadside shop in Faridpur. She is a garment factory worker and lives with her family. She has no significant past medical history. She denies blood in her stool or severe abdominal pain. On examination: pulse 104 bpm, BP 116/73 mmHg, weight 45 kg. Abdomen is soft with mild generalized tenderness. Assessment: Acute gastroenteritis. Plan: a prescription was issued for her care. She was advised to drink small sips of fluid often, eat rice, bananas, and toast, and wash hands before eating. Follow-up in 2 days if the stools do not settle.

Visit note | 2026-06-10 09:00 AM | Dr. Rumana Haque, Endocrinology | Patient: Shathi Miah, 75, female. Mrs. Miah returns for a review of her ongoing condition, reporting that she has been feeling slow and tired, along with dry skin and weight gain. She is a madrasa teacher who first noticed these symptoms when a cold winter in Kushtia felt harder than usual. She has a known history of Type 2 diabetes mellitus. She denies chest pain, dizziness, or visual changes. On examination: TSH 17.5 mIU/L, BP 122/70 mmHg, pulse 81 bpm, weight 66 kg. Heart sounds are normal and reflexes show delayed relaxation. Assessment: Hypothyroidism. Plan: a prescription was issued today. She was advised to keep a regular sleep routine and eat a balanced diet. Follow-up in 6 weeks with a repeat TSH.
